additional_sources.title: Hybrid Linear Attention Done Right: Efficient Distillation and Effective Architectures for Extremely Long Contexts
additional_sources.relevant_claim: per-layer hidden-state-aligned recurrent substitutes, recall-versus-commonsense outcome scoring, top-k attention retention, and long-context hybrid composition

new_overlap_decisions.reason: HALO evaluates every single-layer recurrent replacement on recall and commonsense tasks and retains the top quarter by an explicit importance score
HALO transfers attention projections, independently MSE-aligns every recurrent substitute, and measures the task effect of substituting each layer
HALO spends 320M training tokens plus 234M layer-selection inference-token presentations before joint distillation and reports non-uniform rankings at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B
the selection ablation compares even, latter-half even, RNN-only, Jet-Nemotron, and KL-guided rankings inside HALO
HyPE, recurrent QK normalization, GQA-to-MHA expansion, attention and recurrent output gates, and Lightning Attention are jointly ablated in HypeNet

residual_assessment.distinction: HALO is teacher-conversion selection, observes each layer's selection-task outcomes, and scores independent single replacements rather than predicting unseen jointly trained from-scratch layouts
residual_assessment.cumulative_counterevidence: from-scratch placement recipes are occupied, PAS alignment fails to rank placement quality, and cheap task-guided conversion already produces non-uniform layouts with strong long-context results
residual_assessment.burden: must predict held-out from-scratch multi-layer interactions across tasks, scales, and mixers without layout outcomes, beat HALO/DtR/FlashMorph and all role/activation baselines, and yield architecture value worth its much higher evidence cost
residual_assessment.scientific_value: not established; the residual risks being a more expensive procedural analogue of existing task-guided conversion rather than a new architecture law

source_limitations: HALO selects conversion layouts from a pretrained Transformer rather than from-scratch architectures
the selector directly observes every layer's outcomes on the same task families used in its score
single-replacement sensitivity does not model interactions among the final set of recurrent replacements
the reported selection-method comparison is one 1.7B conversion without layout replicates or uncertainty
Jet-Nemotron and KL-LS are represented by their rankings inside HALO rather than complete original procedures
whole HypeNet serving gains do not isolate the contribution of layer selection

priority.n1: independent claim review must retain or retire the procedural residual; no further landscape artifact execution, protocol, or experiment
priority.baseline_proxy: complete independently because it evaluates the conservative parent rather than either novelty claim

decision.next_action: finish the frozen proxy and obtain independent retention-or-retirement review of N1 before any further placement work
